pages.title: Ministry of Justice (Greece) - Wikipedia
pages.excerpt:
The**Ministry of Justice**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Δικαιοσύνης,[romanized](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romanization_of_Greek):*Ypourgeío Dikaiosýnis*) is the[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))entrusted with the supervision of the[legal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Civil_law_(legal_system))and[judicial system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Judiciary_of_Greece)of[Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece). The incumbent minister is Giorgos Floridis independent, formerly member of PASOK and Prefector of Kilkis.

It was founded as the**State Secretariat for Justice**(Ἡ ἐπὶ τῆς Δικαιοσύνης Γραμματεία τῆς Ἐπικρατείας) on 25 January 1833, and later known as the**Ministry of Justice**([Katharevousa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katharevousa):Ὑπουργεῖον Δικαιοσύνης,[Demotic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demotic_Greek):Υπουργείο Δικαιοσύνης).
